text: **Hint 1:** Examine the scatterplot carefully to determine the pattern or trend of the data points. Consider whether the data can be represented by a linear, quadratic, or other type of function.\n\n**Hint 2:** Consider the effect of each function f(x) on the x-values. For example, f(x) $$=$$ $$-x$$ will reflect the x-values across the y-axis, f(x) $$=$$ $$x$$ will leave them unchanged, f(x) $$=$$ $$x^2$$ will create a parabolic shape, and f(x) $$=$$ |x| will create a V-shape. Determine which transformation, if any, aligns with the pattern in the scatterplot.
